MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

2. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.6
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

3. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

4. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 15
   C. 30
   D. 22

6. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 38
   C. 60
   D. 19

8. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

9. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

10. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

11. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

12. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 0.25
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.025

13. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

14. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.7
   C. 27.6
   D. 33

15. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 11
   C. 100
   D. 50

16. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/4
   D. 3/4

17. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

18. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 12.5
   B. 25
   C. 6
   D. 5

19. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 2

20. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

21. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 m²

22. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

23. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 24.5
   B. 7
   C. 49
   D. 8

24. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 77
   B. 22
   C. 18
   D. 36

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
